status: Development design after inspected v1-v15; freeze before this candidate's outer predictions. Not preregistration or independent confirmation.
anchor: Fixed existing assignment: T for Binder/Wielek, original uHNDI for Mendeley. Gains from this assignment are not supplemental-information gains.

binder.features: Four frequency views. Per actual common channel: five ITPC response/baseline contrasts (response-baseline)/(response+baseline), plus baseline ITPC. 192 fixed fields. Average channel/time contrast and average channel baseline form each view's two marginal-control fields. All windows left-inclusive/right-exclusive. No optional stimulus, raw voltage, new patient exclusions or fine physiological latency claims. Aggregate 500ms-window ITPC samples overlap.

wielek.features: Square-root stage occupancy (5 fields) and square-root full 5x5 lagged joint probabilities at each lag (75 fields). Add 4 times the patient-local independent left/right occupancy prior before normalizing each joint count matrix. Every intervening edge must be valid, consecutive and within the same time_record. No manual stage, eyes, CRS-R, timestamps as classifier values, demographics or duration inputs. Marginal-only control uses the same five occupancy values.
wielek.limit: Released automatic stages, not raw EEG or independently observed consciousness labels. Smoothing precision may depend on observation support; quality controls cannot establish absence of confounding.

mendeley.features: Original v3 clean chronological four-second blocks, same six-channel mean PSD. Convert density to band power by exact band width, divide each block by its five-band total, then concatenate nine linear-interpolation quantiles and the mean per band (50 fields). Each band is one kernel view. Marginal-only control retains five mean relative powers. No new EDF exclusion, PSD frontend, re-referencing, artifact threshold or temporal-order claim. Fixed-QC common power gain cancels in these extras, not in the full method that also contains T.

algorithm: Per cohort fit train-only robust median/IQR scaling (std then1 fallback), asinh two anchors and tanh extras. Average equal-weight RBF kernels over fixed views, each width=median positive off-diagonal train squared distance divided by view dimension (fallback1 if all0). Project the kernel's feature map away from span[1,normalizedT,normalizeduHNDI] using training-only Moore-Penrose inverse. H=I-AA+, Kperp=HKH, Kqueryperp=(Kquery-Aquery A+ K)H. Eigenfeatures retain eigenvalues above 1e-10 times the positive maximum. Fit convex within-cohort positive-negative pair logistic loss with fixed anchor offset and ridge ||beta||^2/2. Main prediction=anchor+kernel correction. This removes only the training linear anchor span, not all conditional dependence; nonlinear anchor-only control is mandatory.
selection: Four main/control candidates: anchor-only first, then ridge1,.1,.01. Mean three-inner-fold AUC, tie1e-12 retains earlier candidate. Each cohort trained separately. No outer-label sign adjustment, best-seed reporting or tuning after these results.
controls: Unprojected uses same kernel and anchor offset, without span projection. Marginal uses only disclosed marginal fields and new learner. Anchor-only uses two normalized anchor columns and the same projected kernel learner. Standalone is kernel pair ranking without anchor offset or projection. Same-input classics and all three recent methods receive exactly asinh-normalized T/uHNDI plus train-normalized full extras, without kernel residualization. Quality-only LR gets four v10 support/retention quantities only. No direct quality values in signal models.

etmc.views: Two-anchor view, every fixed signal kernel view and concatenated pseudo-view. Disclosed vector adaptation, not a full original image model.

roboss.implementation: Paper objective with Gaussian kernel and deterministic L-BFGS adaptation; not original NAG solver.

tabpfn.execution: Official local v2 context, all same-input columns; original float bytes retained in NPZ for prediction replay.

splits: Exactly the existing v10 per-cohort train/test and inner roles, no held-out patient enters any fitted scaler, kernel, eigenspace, width or optimizer.
metric: Mean outer-fold AUC, then five-seed mean, then equal-cohort macro. Pooled calibrated OOF AUC is not the primary metric.
performance_target: Positive macro delta against T and originaluHNDI for each of five seeds; positive five-seed mean delta against both in each cohort; positive mean macro delta against measurement_anchor, marginal_distribution_rank and anchor_only_kernel_rank. Full same-input comparisons retained; no superiority claim without those comparisons and independent confirmation.
novelty_limit: Candidate combination of distributed signal views and baseline-span projected kernel ranking. No constituent priority, clinical mechanism, guaranteed AUC gain or three-center external validation claim. Known cohorts repeatedly inspected; independent patients remain necessary for confirmation.
protection: Frozen protocol and source code before outer predictions; fingerprint original sources, dependencies, all old completed results and manuscripts. Outputs guarded against overwrite. No promotion of favorable control or rewriting negative primary results.
